Thank You for an Amazing MbTech Week 2026!

Made in Manitoba. Building the Future.

Manitoba’s tech community came together to celebrate the vision, talent, and innovation shaping tomorrow, right here at home.

With 50+ events hosted across the province and online, MbTech Week 2026 showcased the strength of our ecosystem. From founders and developers to students, creatives, investors, and business leaders, you demonstrated what’s possible when Manitoba builds together.

To our event hosts, speakers, sponsors, partners, volunteers, and attendees: thank you. Your leadership, ideas, and collaboration are what make MbTech Week a true reflection of Manitoba’s growing digital economy.

2026 Impact KPI

2026 IMPACT

The numbers tell a consistent story: more events, more people, more reach, and an audience that showed up. MbTech Week 2026 delivered 52 events — a 53% increase in programming — with 3,470 participants, a 99% registration demand rate, and a 95% attendance rate. Email reach nearly doubled, community sentiment reached 100% positive, and 1.68M+ people were exposed to MbTech Week through partner + individual amplification. This is the largest, most engaged, and most visible edition in MbTech Week's history.

Telpay Proudly Supports MbTech Week

At Telpay, we believe fintech innovation isn’t just about efficiency—it’s about empowering businesses and shaping the future of finance. That’s why we’re proud to support MbTech Week, celebrating the tech community driving meaningful change.

Automation is no longer optional—it’s a strategic advantage. But true innovation requires trust, security, and seamless integration. Telpay is committed to building solutions that streamline payments, reduce risk, and free teams to focus on strategy and growth.

We’re excited to engage with industry leaders and explore how technology is reshaping business operations. Together, we’re driving the future of automation in finance.

High School Scholarship

Inspiring the Next Generation of Tech Innovators. Tech Manitoba is excited to announce our 2nd annual MbTech Week Scholarship, an initiative to inspire and support high school students passionate about technology and innovation. This scholarship recognizes young talent interested in technology and making meaningful contributions through tech focused courses, camps, extracurricular activities, or personal tech initiatives.

About Tech Manitoba

We empower our members to thrive and grow by connecting people to education, to networking, to mentorship and to business development opportunities. We host MbTech Week as we believe it’s vital to showcase the creativity, the talent, and the expertise behind innovations in Manitoba; and to encourage more connections that help Manitoba grow.

Whether it’s a workshop, tour, panel, or networking event, we want to help you shine during MbTech Week 2026. Host an event and join us in celebrating how Manitoba is building the future, together.

Innovation Champions Proudly Supporting MbTech Week

Skip Canada

At Skip, our roots run deep in Manitoba. From our tech hub in Winnipeg, we're proud to build the marketplace and network that connects millions of Canadians with local businesses every day.

We believe in this province's energy, talent, and vision – the very same spark that makes Tech Week MB such a meaningful celebration. This event highlights more than innovation; it honours the people shaping our future, right here at home.

We're excited to meet fellow innovators, storytellers, and problem-solvers. We can't wait to share our journey, listen to yours, and get inspired by the Manitoba community that's building tomorrow together.

CGI

As a global IT and business consulting leader founded in Canada, CGI is proud to support Manitoba Tech Week 2026.

We help organizations navigate what’s next with confidence, from advancing AI and unlocking the power of data to strengthening cybersecurity and modernizing mission critical systems. True to our proximity model, our teams are rooted in the communities we serve, working alongside our clients in partnership to deliver tangible outcomes.

Manitoba Tech Week is a moment to celebrate the people and ideas shaping Manitoba’s tech future and to continue investing in the province. Here’s to a great week of connection, learning, and inspiration.
